# Map UI column names explicitly to native sort identifiers

The adapter keeps string column names in one map to nsILiveView constants and comparators in another. Current unknown column names fall back to date and invalid directions to descending. Preserve the distinction between a UI name, native enum and ordering predicate when adding a column. This is a local boundary pattern, not a rule that all JavaScript names need enum aliases. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Panorama column naming.
